resources.string: Settings, LUT library and, optionally, this phone\'s measured capabilities, in one .zip file.
Restore a backup made with this app, here or on another phone.
Choose a password to encrypt the backup (AES-256), or leave it empty. Pairings with other phones are never included: they are paired again with a QR.
Without this password the backup cannot be opened. It cannot be recovered.
Include this phone\'s measured capabilities (only used if restored on this same phone and system version)
Measured capabilities: restored (same phone and system version).
Measured capabilities: skipped (another phone or system version); the auto-configuration measures this one.
The recording folder, audio input and second-camera pair belong to the original phone and stay as they are here.
Paired phones are not in backups: pair them again with a QR.
Merge adds the backup to what is here. Replace makes settings and LUT library exactly the backup\'s.
This file is not an UltimateCamera backup.
The backup is damaged or incomplete. Nothing was changed.
This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app to restore it. Nothing was changed.
The file could not be read or written.
